description:
You are a biochemist quantifying protein expression levels from a polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (PAGE) image. A gel image is available at ~/Fiji_Data/raw/gel/protein_gel.tif showing multiple lanes of protein samples separated by molecular weight.

Your goal: Use Fiji's gel analysis workflow to quantify band intensities across all lanes. Specifically:

(1) Open the gel image and orient it correctly (darker bands indicate more protein; you may need to invert if bands appear bright on dark).

(2) Use Fiji's Analyze > Gels workflow: select each lane using rectangular selections, plot lane profiles, and identify peaks corresponding to protein bands.

(3) For each lane, record the integrated intensity of the major protein band. Apply rolling ball background subtraction within each lane profile.

(4) Designate Lane 1 as the reference/loading control lane. Express all other lane intensities as a ratio relative to Lane 1 (normalized intensity = lane_intensity / lane1_intensity).

(5) Save quantification results to ~/Fiji_Data/results/gel/band_quantification.csv with columns: lane_id,raw_intensity,normalized_intensity,background_intensity,peak_area_percent. Save lane intensity profile plots as images to ~/Fiji_Data/results/gel/lane_profiles.png. Save a summary report to ~/Fiji_Data/results/gel/densitometry_report.txt stating which lanes show the highest and lowest expression relative to Lane 1, and listing all normalized values.

metadata.dataset: ImageJ sample gel electrophoresis image (real laboratory gel)
